name: sprite_builder_docuspace_read
description: Read a file OR list a directory in a docuspace. Omit path for the root. Folders are implicit. Returns kind ('file'|'dir'), and either entries[] or content (base64 with binary=true for non-text).

docuspace_id.description: The docuspace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_docuspace / sprite_builder_list_docuspaces).

path.description: Path within the docuspace. Omit for the root.
